title: Every Straight Tunnel Through Earth Takes The Same 42 Minutes
description: AI-narrated science commentary: why a straight tunnel through Earth takes the same time to cross, whether it's a short hop next door or all the way to the far side of the planet. #shorts #sciencefacts #space

hook_candidates.text: A frictionless tunnel through Earth takes the same amount of time to cross, whether it's a short hop next door or a straight trip to the opposite side of the planet.
If you dug a straight tunnel between two cities on Earth, does the short one actually get you there faster than the long one?
You'd assume a longer tunnel through the Earth takes longer to cross -- actually, gravity doesn't work that way down there.

beats.text: A tunnel through Earth takes the **same** time, short hop or clear across.
Gravity inside pulls like a **spring**, not a straight drop.
So next door or the far side of the planet -- both take about **42** minutes. Follow if that surprised you.
